mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the average 20-day return is not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% over a 3-month window signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the mean 20-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand momentum that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative or non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side activity, which reduces inflationary pressure and allows the Fed to maintain accommodative policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 98.0 for two months, or the average 5-day return is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a weakening demand environment that triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a predictive model has a positive or non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month combined with a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market overheating that increases inflation expectations and prompts aggressive Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 5.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to delay rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the interaction term is not negative and significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown that triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 99.0 for 3 consecutive months and UNRATE > 7.0%
regime_hint: supply-side contraction with labor market deterioration
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 99.0 for 3 months and UNRATE > 7.0%, or the interaction effect is not negative and significant (p > 0.05).
